rules.title: Tenants Rights and Resources Notification Ordinance
rules.requirement: Landlords must provide tenants with information about their rights and resources at lease inception and at termination of tenancy, including when legal steps to terminate tenancy are taken. The ordinance does not prevent eviction if otherwise allowed by law but requires that notice of housing rights and resources be provided when eviction proceedings begin.
rules.quoted_span: The Ordinance requires owners, landlords, and management companies to provide you with information at the start of your lease or tenancy as well as when your tenancy is being terminated.
rules.coverage_conditions: All residential rental units in Cambridge including single-unit dwellings; applies to all tenants and lawful occupants at lease inception and at termination proceedings
rules.exemptions: Rental units in hospitals, skilled nursing facilities, health facilities, non-profit facilities with primary purpose of short-term substance abuse treatment, and Short Term Rental Units as defined in Cambridge Zoning Ordinance Article 4, Section 4.60

rule.title: Eviction Process and Resources Information Requirement
rule.requirement: When a landlord initiates eviction proceedings through notice to quit or summary process, the landlord must provide tenants with information about the eviction process and available resources that may mitigate or prevent eviction. The ordinance acknowledges that providing such information may facilitate alternatives to eviction.
rule.quoted_span: if you begin an eviction process through a notice to quit or other action, it is required that you offer the Guide about rights and resources at the same time
rule.coverage_conditions: When legal steps to terminate tenancy are taken including Notice to Quit or Summary Process; applies to all eviction scenarios including non-payment of rent
rule.exemptions: Rental units in hospitals, skilled nursing facilities, health facilities, non-profit substance abuse treatment facilities, and Short Term Rental Units
rule.sanctions: $300 per day of violation (as stated for general ordinance violations)
